note: 100-acre countryside park near Maysville with a pizzeria, petting zoo, hiking trails and two stocked 4-acre fishing ponds. --Claude
summary: Operator pages confirm 60 big-rig sites (back-in and pull-through), 30/50A full hookups, showers, laundry, store, dump, wifi; reservations by phone, no rate posted. Two ~4-acre ponds: not waterfront confirmed. Google 4.5/299; RV Life 4*/61.
flags: PRICE GATE: no rate on the operator's site (reservations by phone). Price indicator: RV Life $$. Camper reports (RV Life): 9/2026 $40 (discount 'Other'), 9/2026 and 8/2026 $50 (Good Sam discount), 5/2026 $45 (no discount) - cheapest real night reported under $50; pass with the caveat that no operator rate was read.
Reviews: Google Maps 4.5 over 299; RV Life 4* over 61 (two 2026 reviews rate it 2/10 and 4/10 for unlevel sites, rutted roads and crowded back pull-throughs). Passes the 4.0 floor.

Long-stay: the site is titled 'Long Term RV Parking' and markets 'daily, weekly and monthly RV parking rates, as well as special rates for long-term guests'. Five tests: (1) price - camper reports $40-50, pass; (2) nightly sold by a phone call with no approval language, and 2026 RV Life reviews are overnighters ('Stayed here a couple nights', 7 days en route, an Airstream caravan for 3 nights) - pass; (3) no minimum stated - pass; (4) transient sites evidently sold nightly - pass; (5) not a home community (pizzeria, petting zoo, trails) - pass. No booking engine for an occupancy check. Keep.

Waterfront: stored 'not waterfront' confirmed. The operator calls them 'two 4-acre fishing ponds'; imagery measures each ~125 x 180 m irregular (~1.8 ha / ~4.5 acres), under the ~5-acre pond line, so no value. The RV loops sit west of the southern pond.

Discounts: stored good_sam false (Good Sam directory, not a Good Sam Park) but two RV Life reviewers (8/2026, 9/2026) list a 'Good Sam' discount at $50 - not written; military true (Good Sam directory) left alone, the operator is silent.
Note: the stored note said 'Veteran-owned'; the operator's site says 'woman-owned' and nothing about veterans. Rewritten without either.
Pin: stored 39.8419,-94.3659 sits at the office/road junction just north of the RV loops (Google's pin 39.84067,-94.36720 is ~150 m SW); within 250 m, no change.
